items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Agents are rounded squares; people are circles.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A status as tone, icon and word.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A glass capsule. Blue is for the one primary action; red text marks refusal.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A native checkbox with its label.

items.name: code
items.title: Code
items.description: Inline code, or a scrollable block.

items.name: error-message
items.title: ErrorMessage
items.description: What went wrong and what to do next.

items.name: gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: A ring that fills to a percentage. Red only past a limit you set.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: IconButton
items.description: A button with only an icon. Its label is required and shows as a tooltip.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key.

items.name: loading-dots
items.title: LoadingDots
items.description: Three dots beside what is happening.

items.name: middle-truncate
items.title: MiddleTruncate
items.description: Shortens the middle of a path or ID and keeps both ends.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: ProgressBar
items.description: Progress toward a known total.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: A native radio with its label.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: The native select, styled. The operating system draws the menu.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between groups.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder while content loads.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A trend with no axes, for a table cell or a stat card.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Something is happening, with no known end.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: StatusDot
items.description: A small mark and a word. Each status has its own shape as well as tone.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off setting that applies immediately.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays on or off.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Extra text on hover and keyboard focus.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message in the page: what happened and what to do.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: A full-width notice in three tones.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: BarChart
items.description: Amounts across categories. More than one series stacks.

items.name: bar-list
items.title: BarList
items.description: A ranking: a name, a bar and a value on every row.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Where you are. Long trails fold the middle.

items.name: browser-frame
items.title: BrowserFrame
items.description: A browser window drawn around a preview.

items.name: budget-meter
items.title: BudgetMeter
items.description: Spend against a limit. It warns at 80% and flags going over.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A day or a range. Arrow keys move by day, Page Up and Down by month.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A glass tile for grouping related content.

items.name: choicebox
items.title: Choicebox
items.description: Card-sized options for a choice that needs a sentence each.

items.name: clearable-input
items.title: ClearableInput
items.description: A text field with a clear button that puts focus back in the field.

items.name: collapse
items.title: Collapse
items.description: Sections that open and close.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Type to filter and pick one. Arrow keys move, Enter picks, Escape closes.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: CommandMenu
items.description: Search everything and act from the keyboard. Press ⌘K or Ctrl+K to see it in use: the search on this site is a CommandMenu.

items.name: confidence-meter
items.title: ConfidenceMeter
items.description: How sure the agent is: a range in words with reasons, never a percentage.

items.name: context-card
items.title: ContextCard
items.description: A preview on hover or keyboard focus. Focus never moves into it.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: ContextMenu
items.description: Opens on right-click, long-press, or Shift+F10.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: CopyButton
items.description: Copies text, shows a check for two seconds, and tells screen readers.

items.name: description
items.title: Description
items.description: Terms and their values.

items.name: destructive-action-modal
items.title: DestructiveActionModal
items.description: For actions that cannot be undone. The red button stays off until the name is typed.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A question over a dimmed page. It traps focus and returns it when closed.

items.name: diff-line
items.title: DiffLine
items.description: One line of a diff, with line numbers and screen-reader text.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: DonutChart
items.description: Parts of a whole, with each slice’s value and share in the legend.

items.name: dots-menu
items.title: DotsMenu
items.description: A "…" button with secondary actions for one row.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: An empty list as an invitation to act.

items.name: entity
items.title: Entity
items.description: An agent or a person as a row.

items.name: error-card
items.title: ErrorCard
items.description: A failure that needs a decision: what broke, the error, and what you can do.

items.name: feedback
items.title: Feedback
items.description: Thumbs up or down, then an optional comment.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, a control, and the hint or error that describes it, wired for screen readers.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: FileTree
items.description: Files and folders with change markers. Arrow keys walk the tree.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: The end of a page: brand, groups of links, and a line for copyright.

items.name: json-view
items.title: JsonView
items.description: JSON as a tree you can fold.

items.name: keyboard-hint
items.title: KeyboardHint
items.description: A shortcut and what it does.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: LineChart
items.description: A trend over time. Point at it, or focus it and press the arrow keys.

items.name: load-more-button
items.title: LoadMoreButton
items.description: A full-width button under a list that says when it is loading.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Actions behind a button. Put destructive ones last, after a separator.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One turn. Yours sit right in a tile; the agent’s are plain text under its name.

items.name: message-list
items.title: MessageList
items.description: A scrolling column that follows new messages until you scroll up.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: ModelPicker
items.description: Chooses which model answers.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: MultiSelect
items.description: Pick several. Picks become chips; Backspace removes the last one.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: The bar across the top. When it gets narrow, the links move into a menu.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page numbers, or a compact previous and next.

items.name: phone-frame
items.title: PhoneFrame
items.description: A phone drawn around content, to show a component at phone size.

items.name: project-banner
items.title: ProjectBanner
items.description: A project-wide notice with one action.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: PromptInput
items.description: Where you write to an agent. Enter sends; Send becomes Stop while it works.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: One choice from a short list.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: The agent’s thinking, folded away behind how long it took.

items.name: relative-time-card
items.title: RelativeTimeCard
items.description: "2 hours ago", with the exact local and UTC time on hover or focus.

items.name: risk-label
items.title: RiskLabel
items.description: How risky an action is, in words.

items.name: scroller
items.title: Scroller
items.description: A horizontal strip that fades where there is more.

items.name: search-input
items.title: SearchInput
items.description: A search field with a shortcut hint, a spinner and a clear button.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge.

items.name: show-more
items.title: ShowMore
items.description: Long content cut to a few lines, with a button to show the rest.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Links down the side, in groups. Collapses to icons that keep their names.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: One value, a range, or steps, read out in words.

items.name: snippet
items.title: Snippet
items.description: Shell commands with a copy button. The prompt sign is never copied.

items.name: sources
items.title: Sources
items.description: What an answer is based on, with numbered markers in the text.

items.name: split-button
items.title: SplitButton
items.description: The common action, with alternatives in a menu.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: StatCard
items.description: One number, what it is, and how it moved.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: StatusBadge
items.description: A status with a running clock.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Where someone is in a fixed sequence. Each status has a shape and a spoken label.

items.name: suggestions
items.title: Suggestions
items.description: Starting points above the input. Choosing one sends it.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Sortable columns, row selection with Shift-click ranges, and bulk actions.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A segmented control and its panels. Arrow keys move between tabs.

items.name: text-with-copy
items.title: TextWithCopy
items.description: Text with a copy button beside it.

items.name: theme-switcher
items.title: ThemeSwitcher
items.description: Light, dark or match the system. This one really switches this page, starting from its current theme.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A short message that rises from the bottom. Call toast() from anywhere.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: A segmented control: pick one, or any.

items.name: tool-call-header
items.title: ToolCallHeader
items.description: Names a tool call and shows its state and attempt.

items.name: video
items.title: Video
items.description: A player with glass controls. It starts muted and never autoplays.

items.name: agent-handoff-banner
items.title: AgentHandoffBanner
items.description: The point where the agent hands control back: outcome, summary, next actions.

items.name: approval-prompt
items.title: ApprovalPrompt
items.description: One specific action to allow or deny. A, Shift+A and D work while focus is inside it.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: A whole conversation with an agent: messages, suggestions and the input. Type something to try it.

items.name: checkpoint-rewind
items.title: CheckpointRewind
items.description: Pick a point to roll back to and see what it undoes before confirming.

items.name: diff-review
items.title: DiffReview
items.description: A decision per hunk before anything lands. J and K move, Y and N decide.

items.name: fleet-sky
items.title: FleetSky
items.description: Many agents at once, as birds on lines back to you. The one that needs you flies in on a taut line.

items.name: kill-switch
items.title: KillSwitch
items.description: Hold for a second to stop the agent. Letting go early does nothing. Space or Enter held does the same.

items.name: needs-you-inbox
items.title: NeedsYouInbox
items.description: Everything blocked on a person, across agents, most urgent first.

items.name: permission-ledger
items.title: PermissionLedger
items.description: Everything you said "Always allow" to, how often it has been used, and a way to take it back.

items.name: plan-editor
items.title: PlanEditor
items.description: Reorder, edit, remove and add steps before anything runs. Alt+Up and Alt+Down move a step.

items.name: question-card
items.title: QuestionCard
items.description: When the agent needs information rather than permission.

items.name: run-timeline
items.title: RunTimeline
items.description: The run's steps and tool calls. It follows the newest step until you scroll up.

items.name: tool-call-card
items.title: ToolCallCard
items.description: One tool call's whole life: input, result, errors and retries.

items.name: agent-run-layout
items.title: AgentRunLayout
items.description: The run screen. It takes organisms as slots, so your app decides what goes where.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShell
items.description: The frame of an app: sidebar, header, content and an optional aside.

items.name: creance-base
items.title: Creance base
items.description: Shared helpers, base styles and the design tokens every Creance component uses.

items.name: creance-chart
items.title: Creance chart helpers
items.description: Shared layout and styles for the chart components.

items.name: agent-run
items.title: Agent run
items.description: The agent event model, useAgentRun and its selectors: turn events from any agent into run state for the agent components.
